name: Ida Brooke
bio: Ida Brooke is known for Silo (2023) and The Primrose Railway Children (2024).

credits.title: Gundam
credits.overview: Rival mech pilots fight on opposite sides of decades-long war between Earth and its space former colonies. As shifting allegiances and a growing threat set them on a collision course for one another, these pilots are pulled into a high-stakes race across the stars that could define the fate of humanity.

credits.title: Through the Lens of a Dying Man
credits.overview: Various peculiar characters visit a man in his final days.

credits.title: Dune: Part Three
credits.overview: Nearly two decades after he seized control of the Imperium, Paul Atreides is now a ruthless Emperor, and must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. credits.title: The Primrose Railway Children
credits.overview: Follow Phoebe, her older sister Becks, younger brother Perry and their mum who are living a comfortable life in Glasgow when suddenly they are uprooted from their lives and moved to the remote highlands of Scotland.
